name: Extra Iaijutsu Technique (Combat)
body:
Your talent in iaijutsu cannot be measured.

Prerequisite(s): Iaijutsu technique class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an iaijutsu technique.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times.
